question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Emerge
solution:
The correct answer is **Disappear.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**emerge"** means to "**appear"**.

 
 
• Therefore, **disappear is the suitable antonym for emerge.**
 
 
 
• The word "**arrive"** means to** reach somewhere**.
 
 
• **Example**- *Yesterday, he arrived at his office quite late.*
 
 
 
• **"Flow"** refers to a **motion**.
 
 
• **Example-** *The river flows.*
 
 
 
• **"Rise"** means to **appear** from somewhere.
 
 
• **Example: ***The sun rises in the east.*
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• An antonym refers to words which are opposite in meaning.
 
 
• **Example**- *Stand and sit*
 
 

* Hot and cold.*
